QuestInfo.name: Mai's Third Training
QuestInfo.1: After you hunted five Red Snails, Mai says it's time for even more powerful monsters. She wants you to hunt #r3 Slimes#k and bring back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k. \n\nSlime #r#a10431##k #i4000004# #t4000004# #b#c4000004# #k/1
QuestInfo.2: After successfully hunting Slimes, you obtained the Squishy Liquid and reported to Mai.

0.0: 빨간 달팽이를 퇴치하고 돌아왔군. 많이 다치지는 않았겠지? 이번에 잡아야 할 몬스터는 더 강한 녀석이라고. 이번에 사냥할 몬스터는 슬라임 3마리야. 슬라임을 사냥하고 녀석에게서 물컹물컹한 액체 1개를 가져오면 돼.

yes.0: 슬라임은 스텀프나 달팽이에 비해 훨씬 빠른데다가 점프를 하기까지 하니까, 조심해서 사냥해. 모아놓은 달팽이 껍질이 있다면 그걸 사용해서 사냥해 보는 것도 좋아. 그럼 행운을 빌게.

no.0: 무섭다면 잠깐 쉬면서 마음의 각오를 다지는 것도 괜찮아.

0.0: I see that you have eliminated the Red Snails. Hope you didn't get too roughed up. Your next mission involves an even more powerful monster. This time, you'll be slaying #r3 Slimes#k. Bring me back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k, too! That's all.

yes.0: Slimes are worlds faster than Stumps and Snails. They also jump around, so you really need to be careful. I suggest you use the skill #bThree Snails#k to attack from a distance. Good luck!

no.0: If you're worried about safety, take some time to calm down and prepare yourself.

item.0: It doesn't look like you've defeated #r3 Slimes#k and brought back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k. I suggest you use some 'Use' items while hunting. They'll definitely help.
